findings.message: The subject or title says what changed for a reader, not which files or functions were touched.
Communicate the why, not just the how.
Place each visual next to the short text it supports. Use one, occasionally two; never all of them.
Describe whether it's a one-way or two-way door. You can walk back through two-way doors, but not one-way doors.
